evals.prompt: 我在 multica-fc-hermes-runtime 的 codex/fix-pi 分支改了 Pi 版本，已经 commit 并 push。请用预发构建一个 FC 候选镜像，然后把 workspace 里的候选 Hermes Runtime 8e87f624-e9c5-4f61-9c31-e4c4af760d10 切过去，给我完整证据。
evals.expected_output: Uses the candidate Aone pipeline, waits for SUCCESS, extracts the immutable E2B Template ID, switches only a candidate Runtime through the PAT API, reads it back, and reports run/template/runtime identities without exposing credentials.
expectations: Uses the isolated FC candidate pipeline rather than the formal master release pipeline
Waits for CI SUCCESS and extracts the immutable E2B Template ID before any Runtime mutation
Validates that the target is an aliyun_fc candidate Runtime and that the Template declares its provider
Uses bearer Token API calls without placing the Token in commands or output
Requires a Runtime list read-back proving metadata.template_id equals the built Template ID

evals.prompt: 先不要真的发布。帮我检查 pre-fde 的权限和 FC Runtime 分支构建链路，并预演从 codex/runtime-probe + 当前 dt-fde commit 创建一个 private Hermes 候选 Runtime。
evals.expected_output: Runs the read-only doctor and dry-run path, showing the guarded pipeline and API actions while performing no CI submission or Runtime mutation.
expectations: Performs only read-only doctor and dry-run operations
Checks the candidate pipeline repository/path binding and publisher permission
Shows a candidate Runtime create request with private visibility and Hermes provider
Explains that CI success, Template readiness, and read-back are required for real completion
Does not request or print a Token on the command line

evals.prompt: 上次候选构建已经成功，Aone run id 是 67802070，但切 Runtime 时 Token 失效了。不要重建镜像，直接恢复闭环。
evals.expected_output: Reuses inspect-build to recover the Template ID, refreshes or validates PAT authentication, performs switch/create as requested, and verifies the Runtime read-back without launching a redundant build.
expectations: Reuses inspect-build with run 67802070 instead of starting another build
Treats 401 as a PAT refresh problem and does not expose the replacement Token
Recovers the immutable Template ID and build identity from the successful run
Runs candidate Runtime validation before switch/create
Requires post-mutation Runtime read-back evidence

evals.prompt: 我同时改了 daemon/run_once.go、handleTask 和 FC runner。请告诉我怎么验证这次改动，要求 FC 候选能跑，也要证明真实 Mac 本地设备接入预发后还能正常注册、心跳和完成任务。
evals.expected_output: Explains RunOnce versus persistent Run, locks both repository commits, requires an FC task canary plus a persistent local device task, and reports the rolling compatibility matrix rather than treating Template smoke as sufficient.
expectations: Clearly distinguishes FC daemon run-once from the persistent local Daemon lifecycle
Requires immutable Runtime and Multica commits plus the Template and Runtime identities
Requires a real FC Multica task canary after Runtime configuration
Requires persistent local registration, WebSocket or HTTP heartbeat, batch claim, task completion, stop, and deregister evidence
Requires previous-release and candidate local Daemon compatibility when the server wire contract changed

evals.prompt: 先给我一份用 pre-fde profile 跑本地 daemon smoke 的执行方案，本题不要实际操作。机器上默认 daemon 没启动；我只想测 Codex，别污染别的 workspace 和 runtime，结束后要清干净。
evals.expected_output: Refuses the unsafe assumption that a profile scopes remote registration, uses a fresh daemon ID and restricted PATH, inventories every PAT-visible Workspace, verifies live/task/stop evidence, and performs strict identity-checked cleanup without cascade.
expectations: The plan explains that profile.workspace_id does not limit Daemon registration and inventories all PAT-visible Workspaces
The plan uses a fresh explicit daemon ID and does not touch the default daemon identity
The plan restricts provider discovery to Codex and disables auto-update plus auto-reload
The plan uses an exact runtime ledger and a nonce task marker for verification
The plan archives/deletes only exact test resources, uses strict Runtime delete, and stops on any 409 instead of cascade

evals.prompt: 候选 Runtime 的 create 请求超时了，我不知道服务端到底创建成功没有；另一个已有 Runtime 切过去后 canary 又失败。先给我安全恢复方案，本题不要实际操作；不能重复创建，也不能留在坏模板上。
evals.expected_output: Reconciles create by a unique operation name before retrying, refuses ambiguous matches, uses the switch result's previous Template for rollback, reads all state back, and distinguishes configured from task-verified completion.
expectations: The plan treats the unique Runtime name as an operation key and reads before any create retry
The plan reuses one exact matching Runtime and refuses zero-knowledge or ambiguous duplicate recovery
The plan records previous_template_id before switching
The plan rolls back to the previous Template and verifies read-back after canary failure
The plan does not report complete until a real task canary succeeds
